spec.title: Subsets
spec.summary: Return every subset of an array of distinct integers, including the empty subset and the entire array.
spec.description: Return every subset of an array of distinct integers, including the empty subset and the entire array. Each subset may appear once, and the subsets may be returned in any order.

examples.explanation: Each value can be included or omitted.
A single value gives two subsets.

approaches.name: Choose or Skip
approaches.summary: Build a partial subset and explore including or skipping each value.
thinkingSteps: Track the current subset and the next index.
Explore the choice to include the next number.
Explore the choice to leave it out and save complete choices.

bullets: Every value can be chosen or left out.
The empty selection is also an answer.
The input has no duplicate values.

approaches.name: Expand Existing Subsets
approaches.summary: For each number, copy every existing subset with that number appended.
thinkingSteps: For each input value, extend a copy of every subset already found.

bullets: Each new value doubles the available choices.
An empty subset gives a starting point.

similar.title: Combination Sum
similar.reason: Explore choices with backtracking, but allow repeated values.
